title_zh: Opening a presentation – 12 – English at Work helps you start the right way
title_en: Opening a presentation – 12 – English at Work helps you start the right way
videoTitle: Opening a presentation – 12 – English at Work helps you start the right way
textbookTitle_zh: 产品介绍的开头：先说今天讲三块什么
note_zh: 整集 3:58。BBC《English at Work》第 12 集，演员真人配音，字幕即官方台词。Anna 对着客户做产品介绍的开场，接近托业第四部分的短讲话。

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.en: It's a big day for Anna. She's about to present Tip Top Trading's new Imperial Lemon to Mr Lime and his colleagues. This must not go wrong.
sentences.zh: 对 Anna 是大日子。她要向 Lime 先生和他的同事介绍 Tip Top Trading 的新 Imperial Lemon。不能出错。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Scared! I want to do really well. If I mess up and Citrus Ventures doesn't place an order, I'll be so upset.
sentences.zh: 我害怕。我想做好。如果我搞砸，Citrus Ventures 不下单，我会非常难受。

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.en: You're well prepared. That's the main thing. Explain clearly how your presentation will be organised.
sentences.zh: 你准备得很充分，这是最要紧的。把介绍的结构说清楚。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: I didn't think of the very beginning. Can you give me examples of what I should say?
sentences.zh: 我没想过最开头。你能给我例句吗？

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.en: After you've introduced yourself, you could say: Today I'm going to… and explain. Then: I'll start by… And then I'm going to move on to discuss… And finally…
sentences.zh: 自我介绍之后可以说 Today I'm going to，再解释。然后 I'll start by，接着 I'm going to move on to discuss，最后 And finally。
sentences.note: Today I'm going to / I'll start by / move on to / And finally. 介绍开头的四步。

sentences.speaker: Mr Lime
sentences.en: Anna! How lovely to see you. I've been looking forward to this for days. Everyone is waiting in the meeting room.
sentences.zh: Anna！见到你真好。我盼这件事好多天了。大家都在会议室等。

sentences.speaker: Mr Lime
sentences.en: Everyone is very excited about this new Imperial Lemon, so I allowed a few extras to come and watch. All your equipment has been set up, so you can begin.
sentences.zh: 大家对这款新柠檬都很兴奋，所以我多让了几个人来看。设备都装好了，你可以开始。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Hello, I'm Anna, of Tip Top Trading. I'm very happy to be here.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是 Tip Top Trading 的 Anna。很高兴来到这里。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Today I'm going to present our revolutionary new Imperial Lemon.
sentences.zh: 今天我要介绍我们全新的 Imperial Lemon。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: I'll start by telling you a bit about Tip Top Trading, and some of the exciting new developments at our company.
sentences.zh: 我先简单说 Tip Top Trading，以及公司一些让人兴奋的新进展。
sentences.note: I'll start by… 告诉听众第一块讲什么。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: And then I'm going to move on to explain how the Imperial Lemon is designed, and what makes it so revolutionary.
sentences.zh: 然后我会转到它是怎么设计的，以及为什么说它是革新。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: And finally, you will all have a chance to see it close up and ask questions. So, let's begin.
sentences.zh: 最后，大家可以靠近看，也可以提问。那我们就开始。

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.en: She used the phrases we discussed, which made her opening clear and well structured.
sentences.zh: 她用了我们刚说的那些句子，开场就清楚、有结构。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: This picture shows— oh no, why isn't it working? I should just click on this. What's wrong with this stupid computer?
sentences.zh: 这张图是——怎么不动？我点一下这个。这台破电脑怎么了？

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.en: It was all going so well, but now Anna's got computer problems.
sentences.zh: 本来很顺利，现在 Anna 的电脑出问题了。
